segments.an3.132:1.3: Pāsāṇalekhūpamo puggalo, pathavilekhūpamo puggalo, udakalekhūpamo puggalo.
segments.an3.132:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an3.132:1.6: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an3.132:1.7: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, pāsāṇe lekhā na khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
segments.an3.132:1.8: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an3.132:1.9: So ca khvassa kodho dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an3.132:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an3.132:2.3: So ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an3.132:2.4: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, pathaviyā lekhā khippaṃ lujjati vātena vā udakena vā, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
segments.an3.132:2.5: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo abhiṇhaṃ kujjhati.
segments.an3.132:2.6: So ca khvassa kodho na dīgharattaṃ anuseti.
segments.an3.132:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo āgāḷhenapi vuccamāno pharusenapi vuccamāno amanāpenapi vuccamāno sandhiyatimeva [… yeva (syā. kaṃ.)… ceva (pī.)] saṃsandatimeva [… yeva (syā. kaṃ.)… ceva (pī.)] sammodatimeva [… yeva (syā. kaṃ.)… ceva (pī.)].
segments.an3.132:3.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, udake lekhā khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
segments.an3.132:3.4: evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo āgāḷhenapi vuccamāno pharusenapi vuccamāno amanāpenapi vuccamāno sandhiyatimeva saṃsandatimeva sammodatimeva.
segments.an3.132:3.6: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin”ti [pu. pa.115].
segments.an3.132:4.3: Kaṭuviyaṃ dve anuruddhā, paṭicchannaṃ lekhena te dasāti.

lines: Gāḷhaṃ katvā pharusaṃ katvā vuccamānopīti attho.
Pāsāṇe lekhasadisā parāparādhanibbattā kodhalekhā yassa so pāsāṇalekhūpamasamannāgato pāsāṇalekhūpamoti vutto.
Na khippaṃ lujjatīti na antarā nassati kammaṭṭhāneneva nassanato.
Evamevanti evaṃ tassapi puggalassa kodho na antarā punadivase vā aparadivase vā niṭṭhāti, addhaniyo pana hoti, maraṇeneva niṭṭhātīti attho.
Atha vā sandhiyatīti ṭhānagamanādīsu kāyakiriyāsu kāyena samodhānaṃ gacchati, tilataṇḍulā viya missībhāvaṃ upetīti attho.
Saṃsandatīti cittakiriyāsu cittena samodhānaṃ gacchati, khīrodakaṃ viya ekībhāvaṃ upetīti attho.
Sammodatīti uddesaparipucchādīsu vacīkiriyāsu vācāya samodhānaṃ gacchati, vippavāsāgatopi piyasahāyako viya piyatarabhāvaṃ upetīti attho.
Apica kiccakaraṇīyesu tehi saddhiṃ ādītova ekakiriyābhāvaṃ upagacchanto sandhiyati, yāva majjhā pavattanto saṃsandati, yāva pariyosānā anivattanto sammodatīti veditabbo.
